name: aseprite
description_en: Animated sprite editor & pixel art tool (Windows, macOS, Linux)
readme_excerpt: Aseprite Introduction Aseprite is a program to create animated sprites. Its main features are: Sprites are composed of layers & frames as separated concepts. Support for color profiles and different color modes: RGBA, Indexed (palettes up to 256 colors), Grayscale. Animation facilities, with real-time preview and onion skinning.
